arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import datetime, uuid

summary = "Team Meeting"
description = "Weekly team meeting"
tzid = "Asia/Shanghai"

dtstart = datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 5, 15, 0, 0)
dtend = datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 5, 16, 0, 0)

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"
dtstamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    f"DTSTART;TZID={tzid}:{dtstart.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
    f"DTEND;TZID={tzid}:{dtend.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
    f"SUMMARY:{summary}",
    f"DESCRIPTION:{description}",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    f"DESCRIPTION:Reminder: {summary} starts in 15 minutes",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
    "",
]

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\r\n") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines))

print("Wrote team_meeting.ics")
print("Event: Team Meeting on", dtstart.strftime("%A, %Y-%m-%d %I:%M %p"), "-", dtend.strftime("%I:%M %p"), tzid)
print("UID:", uid)
EOF
